styleLock.direction: warm reassuring bulk-pack baby care commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio sweeps alternating a #FBF8F3 paper field and a #2F938D lake-teal field, with cream muslin textile as the only soft furnishing; info screens use blank bands and blank label plates instead of rendered copy
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused key from the upper left with a bounce fill on the shadow side, gentle true contact shadows, no harsh speculars; night screens drop to one low warm source while keeping the same falloff language
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte paper panels #FBF8F3 and #F0DFA8, rumpled cream muslin, quilted cloth #E7DCCB, plain unprinted kraft board for the outer carton
styleLock.typography: single modern geometric sans-serif family, wide headline bands kept empty so copy is composited later; no script, no rounded display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded or circular badge outlines in #1F4B50, no filled seals, no award artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: pack stays upright at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with fixed scale across screens; opened diaper always shows inner surface toward camera; infants appear only as neck-down crops, backs of head, small hands or feet
noDrift: no brand marks, award seals, ratings or readable on-image copy
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm reassuring bulk-pack baby-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper white #FBF8F3, lake teal #2F938D, butter cream #F0DFA8 and ink teal #1F4B50; neutral balanced studio temperature; soft diffused key from the upper left with bounce fill and gentle true contact shadows; seamless studio sweeps with cream muslin textile as the only furnishing; modern geometric sans-serif in one family only with headline bands kept empty; thin single-weight line icons and empty badge outlines in #1F4B50; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 pack angle with fixed scale; infants shown only as neck-down crops, backs of head, small hands or feet; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks or award seals.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 箱装正面加顶部横幅主张并有成人抱婴侧影；002 床上躺卧亲子与竖排承诺胶囊（含推荐排名、无香、零添加、皮肤检测四行）；003 展开尿裤配三处箭头标注与圆形内嵌特写；004 床面母婴与三行主张横幅；005 医护人物与三枚奖章角标；006 尿裤平铺配隔边箭头与百分比主张；007 内衬压点微距与倍数主张；008 夜睡婴儿与百分比家长背书；009 拱形开窗人像与排名主张；010 左尺码表右躺卧婴儿（含各码体重区间）；011 五星评价引述气泡加抱婴人像；012 穿用腰围特写加卡通动物圆形插图；013 双拱门按压试片对比并有竞品名与倍数注脚；014 箱装加 companion 湿巾包的连带购买版式；015 至 018 牛皮纸外箱正视、侧视、透视四张近重复。品类判定依据：图像为腰贴式婴儿纸尿裤零售大包加整箱外箱，与提示的母婴/纸尿裤一致，故 L1 取「母婴」、L2 逐字取「纸尿裤」，productFamily 取 home 与库内同 L2 保持一致。已剥离内容：品牌字标、系列名、心形标识与卡通动物插图、全部横幅与标语原句、星级与用户引述、推荐排名与百分比及倍数类主张、码号与体重区间与片数等号型数量信息（尺码表改为空白表格单元）、外箱条码与箱面字样、平台角标与奖章、全部模特与婴儿面容身份（婴儿仅以颈下裁切、背影、小手小脚出现）。
